fields.incidentName: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur
fields.issuedBy: Chief Pruitt, Rook County Fire Department
fields.area: Everyone within 0.4 miles northeast of Harlan Spur, including Elm Street Elementary and the Harlan Road homes.
fields.instructions: Go inside, close windows and doors, turn off ventilation, and stay until told otherwise. Do not drive toward the spur.
fields.distanceSource: Invented exercise distance for a fictional material. Players use their own guidebook for real decisions.
